blocks.heading: CME's and Cboe's documentation complexity
paragraphs: The futures and options exchanges' rulebooks are extraordinarily complex — the CME Group rulebook runs to thousands of pages with frequent amendments, interpretive notices, and regulatory guidance letters. RAG that makes this documentation queryable in natural language has enormous value for compliance officers, traders, and risk managers at Chicago's large financial community who currently rely on manual search or expensive outside counsel for complex regulatory questions.

paragraphs: Advocate Aurora's 26 hospitals and 1,000+ sites of care create an institutional knowledge management challenge at a scale that most health systems don't approach — the sheer volume of clinical protocols, policy documents, and operational procedures creates a RAG knowledge management ROI that is clear and substantial.

Chicago's CPG sector has become one of the US's most active RAG deployment markets for enterprise knowledge management.
